SELECT false_alarm, shift_code, COUNT(*) AS incident_count, SUM(downtime_min) AS total_downtime_min, SUM(cars_lost) AS total_cars_lost FROM sf_ops.incidents WHERE kind = 'machine_overheat' AND ts >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND ts < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY false_alarm, shift_code ORDER BY incident_count DESC
LIMIT 200
